title: Specific charge expression
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for part (1) must be correctly derived and expressed as q/m = 4U/(d²B²).

title: Total time expression
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for part (2) must be correctly derived and expressed as t = (π/8 + √3/12) * (d²B/U).

title: Velocity from acceleration
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly apply the work-energy theorem to find the initial velocity v₀ = √(2qU/m).

title: Trajectory radius geometry
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly relate the geometric distance d to the radius r of the circular motion, establishing r = (√2/2)d.

title: Magnetic force as centripetal
description: Important Criteria: The solution must apply Newton's second law for circular motion, equating qvB to mv²/r.

title: Path segmentation and times
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly calculate the time in the magnetic field (quarter-circle arc) and the time from exit to the x-axis (straight line).

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional Criteria: The final expressions for specific charge and time should have dimensionally correct units (C/kg and s, respectively).

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the solution incorrectly assigns the direction of the magnetic force, leading to an erroneous curvature of the path.

title: Geometry misinterpretation
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the 30° angle or the distance d is misinterpreted, leading to an incorrect radius or straight-line distance S₂.
